title: Herd 1.11 Now Available
content: <html><head></head><body>We're thrilled to announce the next big step for Laravel Herd, making the best development environment for macOS and Windows users even better. This update ships an integration with Laravel Forge, a profiler, a way to store your project configuration in your repository, and massive improvements for the dump debugger.</body></html>
author: Taylor Otwell
